subject: Exec liaison tilt + EB meeting sync windows for close plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Miles <lauren.miles@acmeapp.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@acmeapp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Exec liaison tilt + EB meeting sync windows for close plan

Hi Lauren / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. To keep momentum toward your Q4 launch, we want to lock an Executive Briefing (EB) with the right sponsor set and align on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so timelines are clear. Two asks:

1) Exec sponsor mapping: who are the final decision-makers you want in the EB? Please indicate primary sponsor + any alternate execs (title + role in decision).
2) EB windows: proposed 90-minute slot options in the next two weeks so we can reserve senior engineering and product leaders on our side.

We typically run the EB as: 15 min context + 40 min technical deep-dive + 20 min MAP walkthrough + 15 min commercial/Q&A. If you prefer a shorter format, tell us and we’ll adapt.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Aug 24: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Aug 25: 09:00–10:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Fri Aug 27: 11:00–12:30

I’ve attached a draft MAP (Acme_MAP_v2.xlsx) so you can see the milestones we suggest (evaluation gates, security/compliance checkpoints, procurement timelines). If you can map exec names to the rows and flag any missing gates, we’ll iterate.

Next steps: if you can reply with sponsor names + preferred window, we’ll circulate a formal invite and runbook.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0192
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Monica —

Thanks, this is helpful. High level sponsor mapping below (titles are how they want to appear on calendar invites):

- Primary sponsor: Priya Agarwal, VP Product (decision owner for platform vendor selection)
- Technical approver: Rajesh Iyer, Head of Infrastructure (will lead technical Q/A)
- Security reviewer (optional): Lisa Chow, Sr. InfoSec Manager (may attend for the compliance section)

On windows: Wed Aug 25 14:00–15:30 PT works best for Priya and Rajesh. Tom can make Tue Aug 24 15:00–16:30 if needed, but we’d prefer Wed.

We reviewed the MAP spreadsheet quickly — looks reasonable. Two notes: add a SOC2 evidence collection milestone and a procurement legal review slot (we usually need 10 business days for standard PO + SOW).

I’ll confirm final names and whether Lisa will join by EOD tomorrow.

—Lauren

Monica / Priyom —

Wed Aug 25 14:00–15:30 PT is fine from my side for the EB. I’ll hold senior infra (Marcus, Rahul) tentatively but need attendee roster by Monday to lock diaries.

Monica: can you export a one-page runbook from the MAP that highlights the evaluation gates + who owns each gate (Redwood vs Acme)? That will make the EB flow cleaner and help Priya see milestones up-front. Also, add a short SOC2 evidence checklist row (Lisa Chow flagged it).

Priyom: please prepare 5–7 slides for the MAP walkthrough: 1 slide per milestone + ownership + target dates; add a final slide with procurement timeline and approval path. I put the working template in the shared drive link below.

Related: I’ll draft a proposed SOW timeline showing a fast path (45 days post-sign) vs standard (75 days). We should be ready to show both during Q&A.

Thanks — Ben

Attached: Acme_MAP_v2.xlsx (updated with SOC2 evidence row), Redwood_EB_Prep_Slides.pdf (Ben/Priyom starter deck), EB_Attendee_Roster.csv (names/titles and time zones). Please review the MAP rows highlighted in yellow and confirm the owner for the procurement milestone (we listed Legal - Acme; change if inaccurate).

Action items before the EB:
- Acme: confirm Lisa Chow’s attendance or permission to record the compliance section (due by Mon Aug 23 EOD).
- Acme: confirm final attendee list and spelling (Mon Aug 23 EOD).
- Redwood: Priyom to upload final slides by Tue Aug 24 12:00 PT; Ben to prepare SOW timelines.

If anything changes, flag immediately and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to a productive session.
